title: Image prompts get LlamaGuard checks
summary:
LlamaGuard adds image-prompt checks and feed maturity metadata, while Pal Chat joins the community project listings.

Image generation gained LlamaGuard prompt classification. Prompts flagged for both mature and child-exploitation content are rejected, and repeated prohibited-content requests from the same IP are blocked.

Feed listeners excluding NSFW content now account for additional maturity flags. The end_generating event gained a nested maturity field and no longer includes originalPrompt. LlamaGuard 7B AWQ was also added as a safety model in the text API.

Pal Chat, an iOS app that puts Pollinations models and other LLMs in one chat interface, was added to the README and website project listings.

daily.title: LlamaGuard joins the text API
daily.text: Use LlamaGuard 7B AWQ for safety classification through the text API. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
